::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 10th 1873  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS National Library of Wales 11,981E
:::

Dear Madam
I am much obliged for your enclosure which is valuable and interesting, and shews how it was that only a year later [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd)was able to gain the scholarship at Corpus

with many thanks
yours very truly
C M Yonge
